notes: §1985:XI.2.3.3 SR2: "Since file-name-1 represents a sort or merge file, only the ASSIGN clause is permitted to follow file-name-1 in the FILE-CONTROL paragraph." BindFileControl records OPTIONAL and every non-ASSIGN clause of an entry in FileModel.BeyondAssign; FileControlKeyRules.Screen, for a sort-merge file below DialectLevel 2002, reports COBOL1900 once per such clause in place of the 2023 Format-4 rows. Witness: an SD's entry adding ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL is refused at 85, accepted at 2023. Probes at 85 (b/c/e): OPTIONAL, FILE STATUS, ACCESS MODE, RESERVE, bare SEQUENTIAL, ORGANIZATION before ASSIGN, ORGANIZATION RELATIVE+RELATIVE KEY, INDEXED+RECORD KEY, PADDING CHARACTER, RECORD DELIMITER, LOCK MODE each refused COBOL1900 (one per clause, also for a MERGE file); ASSIGN USING refused COBOL0900; ASSIGN twice refused COBOL2423; ASSIGN TO literal and ASSIGN TO implementor-name DISK sorted and printed 'AAA'. At 2002 bare SEQUENTIAL is accepted. Read 6 (2026-11-14, records-read6): the row had no verdict and no test-ref although its witness existed; the reader read CONFORMS and an independent refuter UPHELD it (op-20261114/out-read6/rd-NN.json and rd-NN-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 allows only the ASSIGN clause after the sort or merge file-name (format: SELECT file-name-1 ASSIGN TO implementor-name/literal). §2023:12.4.5.2 SR13 requires Format 4 for a sort-merge file, and Format 4 of §2023:12.4.5.1 also admits ASSIGN USING data-name-1 and an optional '[ [ ORGANIZATION IS ] SEQUENTIAL ]'. 2023 accepts sort-merge file control entries 1985 refused; a 1985 entry (ASSIGN only) means the same. Looser.
